profiles.description: European Union: VAT-inclusive display required in B2C; GDPR data-subject rights apply.
profiles.compliance_note: GDPR compliant. Price includes VAT as required by EU consumer law.

profiles.description: India: Goods and Services Tax. B2B buyers can claim input tax credit; B2C display is typically tax-inclusive.
Brazil: LGPD is a data-privacy regulation. Brazilian tax law (ICMS/PIS/COFINS) is complex and product-specific. Velo displays a compliance label; consult local tax counsel for filing obligations.
profiles.compliance_note: LGPD compliant. Applicable taxes may vary by product and state. Consult local counsel.

profiles.description: Regions with no applicable VAT/GST configuration (e.g. USA, UAE free zones). Tax display is omitted.
